title: Reproductive Health Screening Assessment
subtitle: Progressive, non-diagnostic pattern analysis calibrated for your endocrine pathway
nonDiagnosticNotice: This assessment provides probability estimates and educational feature attributions based on statistical models. It is not a clinical diagnosis.

tierSelection.tier2Desc: Hormonal panels (LH, FSH, Testosterone, Glucose, Lipids) for increased precision.
tierSelection.tier3Desc: Pelvic ultrasound features including follicle counts and ovarian volume.

lifeStage.guidelineNotice: 2023 International Evidence-Based PCOS Guidelines: Adult Rotterdam criteria cannot be applied uncritically to adolescents or postmenopausal women.

explainability.header_title: Why did BioPulse give me this screening result?
explainability.header_subtitle: BioPulse evaluates your complete submitted evidence profile across 5 cross-validation folds. Below are the primary clinical and physiological factors that influenced your result before final calibrated scoring:
explainability.higher_title: Factors that pushed your result higher
explainability.lower_title: Factors that supported a lower result
explainability.no_higher_factors: No dominant risk-elevating factors were detected in this filter.
explainability.no_lower_factors: No dominant risk-lowering factors were identified in this filter.
explainability.ultrasound_subtitle: Gradient-weighted Class Activation Mapping highlights pixel regions in your transvaginal scan that most strongly activated the convolutional vision model.
explainability.warm_colors: Warm colors (red/yellow) indicate highest model attention
explainability.rotterdam_desc: Polycystic ovarian morphology (PCOM) corresponds to ≥20 follicles per ovary and/or ovarian volume ≥10 mL, evaluated independently from clinical lab risk.
explainability.pillar_clinical_desc: Derived from 32 questionnaire, biometric, and laboratory features via calibrated Extra Trees. Governs the quantitative risk estimate.
explainability.pillar_ultrasound_desc: Evaluated independently via EfficientNet-B0 Grad-CAM for Rotterdam Criterion 3 polycystic morphology without distorting clinical SHAP attributions.
